evidence.summary: Trade-off (computed from DB-1, BIZ-2, BIZ-4): batch_replayable_month_end_close: expected remaining runtime ~3596s, so waiting costs ~$808,700 of checkout revenue at the current loss rate and EXCEEDS the 60s degradation the business tolerates; terminating costs a 95-minute replay of inventory_month_end_close (policy may_interrupt).
